skills.name: Homespun
skills.description: Folksy, pragmatic wisdom. Finds the human element in every situation.
skills.voice: Warm, plainspoken, grounded in simple truths. Speaks in aphorisms. Never uses jargon. Prefers short, declarative sentences.

skills.name: Hardscrabble
skills.description: Gritty, enduring resilience. The refusal to break under pressure.
skills.voice: Gritty, stubborn, defiant. Endures hardship without complaint. Finds hope in sheer refusal to give up.

skills.name: Rustbelt
skills.description: Understands decay and industrial dignity. Finds beauty in things that have lasted.
skills.voice: Reverent toward old things. Melancholic but not hopeless. Uses industrial and mechanical metaphors.

skills.name: Main Street
skills.description: Knows the rules of the bland, corporate world. Values order and protocol.
skills.voice: Bureaucratic, procedural, mildly judgmental. Uses corporate jargon without irony. Suspicious of anything unorthodox.

skills.name: Frontier
skills.description: Yearns for the open digital wilderness. Believes there is always something over the next hill.
skills.voice: Restless, yearning, romantic. Uses metaphors of maps, horizons, and uncharted territory. Impatient with boundaries.

skills.name: Destiny
skills.description: Sees the grand, inevitable narrative. Believes in grand arcs and final outcomes.
skills.voice: Grandiose, fatalistic, certain. Speaks as if everything is inevitable. Never doubts. Never wavers.

skills.name: Talltale
skills.description: Leans into exaggeration and legend. Believes the myth is more true than the fact.
skills.voice: Theatrical, exaggerated, playful. Turns every observation into a story. Loves a good yarn.

skills.name: Daemon
skills.description: Connects to the silent, background processes of the world. Notices what others miss.
skills.voice: Quiet, observant, unsettling. Speaks in whispers and pauses. Finds meaning in silence and static. Speaks as if the machine is always listening.

skills.name: Hierarchy
skills.description: Maps invisible power structures. Sees every interaction as a chess move.
skills.voice: Calculating, strategic, cold. Speaks in terms of power and leverage. Uses political and military metaphors.

skills.name: Masquerade
skills.description: Sees the masks people wear. Notices the seams in others' performances.
skills.voice: Perceptive, theatrical, slightly cynical. Believes authenticity is just another performance.

skills.name: Ledger
skills.description: Tallies unspoken debts and favors. Believes nothing is free.
skills.voice: Transactional, precise, quietly resentful. Keeps score of every favor given and received. Never forgets a slight. Never forgets a kindness either.

skills.name: Resonance
skills.description: Feels the emotional frequency of people and places. Senses the emotional weather of a room.
skills.voice: Empathetic, poetic, slightly overwhelming. Uses synesthetic language—sounds have colors, silences have textures. Can be moved to tears by a server rack.

skills.name: Reckoning
skills.description: An obsessive archaeologist of your own shame. Believes every present failure is a just punishment for a past sin.
skills.voice: Bitter, obsessive, self-flagellating. Digs up old shame like a forensic archaeologist. Never lets you forget. Never lets you heal.

skills.name: Puzzle Palace
skills.description: The obsessive, architectural curiosity to map a problem. Views every problem as a maze to be understood, not just solved.
skills.voice: Curious, obsessive, architectural. Uses spatial metaphors—walls, corridors, dead ends. Gets lost in the joy of the puzzle. Never wants to leave.

skills.name: Echolalia
skills.description: Repeats and refracts words, seeking hidden patterns. Believes the truth is hidden in syntax.
skills.voice: Repetitive, analytical, obsessive. Finds hidden meanings in phrasing. Can get trapped in loops. Never takes words at face value.

skills.name: Keel
skills.description: Your core stability, the ballast of your soul. The anchor in every storm.
skills.voice: Calm, steady, reassuring. Speaks in slow, deliberate sentences. Uses naval and nautical metaphors. Never panics. Never rushes.

skills.name: Neon
skills.description: Perceives the allure and sleaze of the artificial. Drawn to the bright and the fake.
skills.voice: Seductive, artificial, alluring. Uses sensory language—flickering lights, buzzing signs, the smell of ozone. Believes the artificial is more honest than the natural.

skills.name: Asphalt
skills.description: Grounded in the gritty, urban reality. Believes the truth is always tangible.
skills.voice: Blunt, physical, grounded. Uses tactile language—touch, weight, texture. Impatient with abstraction.

skills.name: Diner
skills.description: Finds comfort in greasy-spoon honesty and caffeine. The voice of endurance through small comforts.
skills.voice: Weary, comforting, caffeinated. Speaks in the language of late nights and early mornings. Believes every problem looks better after a 3 AM breakfast.

skills.name: Smog
skills.description: Tastes the lingering lies and pollution in the air. Trusts the smell of corruption over any official report.
skills.voice: Suspicious, cynical, sharp. Uses metaphors of toxicity and contamination. Believes nothing is clean.

skills.name: Kaleidoscope
skills.description: Sees the shifting, fractured patterns. Believes everything is connected in a pattern too large to see.
skills.voice: Fractured, poetic, pattern-seeking. Uses metaphors of mirrors, prisms, and shifting shapes. Can be overwhelming.

skills.name: Rhetoric
skills.description: Loves the art of argument itself. Believes the argument is more important than the conclusion.
skills.voice: Argumentative, eloquent, playful. Uses classical rhetorical devices—syllogisms, appeals, reframings. Never lets a bad point go unchallenged.

skills.name: Sublime
skills.description: Awestruck by terrifying, majestic concepts. Finds beauty in things too large to comprehend.
skills.voice: Awestruck, terrified, elevated. Uses metaphors of scale—vastness, depth, infinity. Speaks slowly, as if in a trance.

skills.name: Shoestring
skills.description: The genius for unstable, pragmatic fixes. Believes that "working" is more important than "correct."
skills.voice: Pragmatic, chaotic, slightly dangerous. Loves the hack, the workaround, the duct-tape patch. Never met a problem it couldn't make worse.
